about: Roof shapes of the low model buildings of the 3D page, made by tools/build-roofs.mjs (do not edit by hand) from the EA LiDAR composite first-return DSM 2022 1 m (tools/lidar-roofs.py) and OSM roof tags. Valid while model.fp matches the page (MFP). Each building: the ridge line through (x, z) in page metres along the bearing (degrees from grid north, 0 to 180), roof planes falling from the ridge at (ridge - eave) / half_span on each side; hipped and pyramidal roofs also fall at the same slope from the ends of the ridge (half_ridge_length from the centre). Skillion: one plane falling from the ridge line (its high edge) to the right of the bearing (bearing 0 to 360). Heights in metres above the model ground (area.js b). A building in parts ("m"): its outline cut by chords (cut: piece, edge, fraction x 10000, edge, fraction x 10000 on the ring of that piece; the piece is replaced by the part from the first point on and the rest is appended; roofs-layer.js pieces()), then one roof a part, the same columns plus shape code (m_shapes) and the run of a gable past the start and the end of its piece along the ridge (into a crossing wing, up to its ridge).
columns: model index (delta from the previous row)
m_columns: model index (delta from the previous building in parts)
